title: Which customers, paying in CZK, consumed the most gas in 2011?
question: Which customers, paying in CZK, consumed the most gas in 2011?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers_yearmonth AS T1
WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND T1.Date LIKE '2011%'
GROUP BY T1.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(T1.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1
